response.justification: Bogdan brings extensive full-stack experience across TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK, with strong alignment to the required stack and AI-agent work. His deep engineering background, open-source contributions, and demonstrated ability to own end-to-end systems make him a strong fit, though his German language limitation and lack of explicit Nest.js/Vitest experience are minor gaps.
strengths: 6+ years of proven full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and React
Direct experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks
Strong DevOps and infrastructure skills (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitLab)
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in resume or projects
German language proficiency is only basic, may hinder collaboration in Berlin-based team
Resume lacks clear metrics on scalability or performance improvements in key roles
